_meta.purpose: Standalone AI image generation + design profile for lifestyle/awareness social posts
_meta.aesthetic: Warm Earthy Luxury Editorial — extracted from ESTHBeautyInc 36-tile grid analysis
_meta.use_case: Posts that keep your social media page alive — service emphasis, mood, aspirational beauty content
_meta.NOT_for: App UI, brand identity, or feature announcements — those use brand-profile.json
_meta.source: design.md — ESTHBeautyInc Design System & Style Guide

core_aesthetic.name: Warm Earthy Luxury Editorial
core_aesthetic.feel: Like afternoon sunlight streaming through linen curtains — warm, intimate, glowing, effortlessly elegant

honey_gold.usage: Warm overlay tint on photography, accents

deep_amber.usage: Accent text, decorative elements, bullet markers

warm_taupe.usage: Muted background for contrast tiles, pill borders

charcoal_warm.usage: Primary body text on light backgrounds

pure_white.usage: Text on dark/photo backgrounds, pill outlines

photography_temperature.rule: All imagery warm-shifted — golden-hour amber tones
photography_temperature.shadows: Brown/sepia, never blue or cool gray
photography_temperature.highlights: Warm amber/orange push, not blown-out white

strict_no_go: #16a34a emerald green — app UI only, never social posts

1_brand_mark.color: matches headline color or white on photo

2_kicker.usage: Eyebrow above headline — 'The Benefits of', 'The Truth About', 'Why'

3_headline.italicRule: Italicize 1–2 key words — the ingredient, treatment name, or action verb

headline_italic_rule.description: The signature move — in every multi-word headline, 1–2 words are italic, the rest roman. Creates visual 'bounce'.
headline_italic_rule.italic_words_are: The key ingredient, treatment name, or action verb

accent_script.usage: Rare — 1 in 10 tiles. A single word in brush/handwritten script for extra emphasis.
accent_script.font: Casual brush script or handwritten italic

asterisk_motif.placement: Floating near headline (top-right of a keyword), or standalone in a corner
asterisk_motif.role: Brand signature / quality seal / decorative flourish — the most important recurring motif

pills_tags.usage: Listing treatments, benefits, steps — arranged in cloud/scatter or inline

info_bubbles.arrangement: Scattered cloud layout — never strict grid
info_bubbles.usage: Post-treatment care steps, benefit lists, quick tips

thin_rule.usage: Section separator between headline and body — minimal, never decorative border

arrow.usage: Before URL ('→  www.serviceflow.store') and before CTAs ('→  Follow for more!')

A_photo_overlay.description: Full-bleed photography. Headline overlaid bottom-left or center. No background card — text lives directly on photo.
A_photo_overlay.overlay: Slight warm dark gradient or photo's own tonal contrast handles legibility
A_photo_overlay.best_for: Service spotlight, mood posts, single bold statement
A_photo_overlay.example: Dewy skin close-up + overlay 'Why Professional Extractions *Matter*?' in white Playfair Display

B_split_photo_info.description: Left half: close-up photo. Right half: warm-cream solid background with headline + bullet list. OR top/bottom split.
B_split_photo_info.divider: Colors abut cleanly — no harsh divider line
B_split_photo_info.best_for: Service explainers, tip lists, treatment benefits
B_split_photo_info.example: Photo left: hands holding serum. Right: cream bg, headline '*Vitamin C* Serum', 3 bullet benefits

C_product_showcase.description: Light/cream background. Product image centered or offset. Large serif headline wraps around product. Lots of white space.
C_product_showcase.example: Off-white bg, amber dropper bottle center, 'Collagen *Boosting* Cream' serif headline wrapping

D_text_educational.description: Warm beige/cream bg. Structured info — bullet lists, numbered steps, pill tag clouds. Headline at top.
D_text_educational.best_for: How-to guides, layering order, skincare routines
D_text_educational.example: Warm cream bg, 'How to *Layer* Skincare Products', steps in DM Sans with ◆ bullets

E_teaser_engagement.description: Same warm palette. More playful/mysterious — 'Coming Soon', 'Ask Your Esthetician!', sneak peeks.

composition_rules.text_alignment: Left-aligned or center-left — NEVER centered like a greeting card
composition_rules.multi_line_headline: Lines stack vertically with tight leading (0.95) — form a compact visual block
composition_rules.crop: Tight — subject fills 70–100% of frame. Product may be partially cropped at tile edge.
composition_rules.depth_of_field: Shallow — background always soft/blurred warm bokeh
composition_rules.negative_space: Deliberately positioned for text overlay placement — not accidental

subjects: Extreme close-up face/skin — dewy, glowing, sun-kissed. Chin to forehead, or isolated cheeks/lips/jawline.
Hands + product — dropper bottles, serums, creams being applied or held — natural, unposed
Texture shots — cream swatches on skin, foam, water/oil droplets
Body fragments — shoulders, collarbones, hands — always intimate, never full body
Single product on warm surface — partially cropped at edge is fine

lighting.type: Golden hour / warm studio side-light or backlight
lighting.quality: Soft diffused — no harsh shadows, no flash, light leaks and lens flare are welcome
lighting.effect: Warm halo/glow on skin and product edges

color_grading.skin: Warm, luminous, slightly golden — like shooting through a honey-colored filter
color_grading.saturation: Slightly desaturated overall, warm tones preserved
color_grading.film_feel: Optional slight grain for texture and authenticity

composition.negative_space: Intentional — placed where headline text will live

ai_generation_prompts.master_photo_prompt: Luxury beauty editorial photography, extreme close-up Filipino skin macro, warm golden-hour light, amber earthy tones, cream and honey color palette, dewy glowing sun-kissed skin, shallow depth of field warm bokeh, soft side-lighting or backlighting, warm LUT color grade — amber highlights sepia shadows, slight film grain, 4:5 portrait OR 1:1 square, intimate unposed feeling, ESTHBeautyInc editorial aesthetic
ai_generation_prompts.skin_close_up: Extreme close-up Filipino skin, dewy moisture glow, visible skin texture, warm amber sidelight, sun-kissed caramel skin tone, cream background bokeh, luxury skincare editorial photography, warm honey color grade, intimate tight crop
ai_generation_prompts.hands_product: Hands holding amber glass dropper bottle, warm studio light, serum being applied on skin, honey-toned skin, warm earthy background, close-up tight crop, unposed natural feeling, luxury beauty editorial, warm LUT, no cool tones
ai_generation_prompts.product_standalone: Amber glass serum bottle on warm cream linen surface, soft warm side-lighting, subtle product shadow, warm off-white background #FAF6EF, luxury skincare product photography, honey color grade, no cold tones, partially cropped at edge
ai_generation_prompts.ambient_mood: Luxury spa texture, warm cream linen, amber wood tones, skincare products arranged on warm surface, golden afternoon light through sheer curtains, warm earthy mood, no people, ambient editorial shot

text_overlay_spec.italic_rule: Set 1–2 key words in italic — the treatment name, ingredient, or action verb. Everything else roman.
text_overlay_spec.kicker_above: Optional small DM Sans kicker above headline — e.g. 'The Benefits of' or 'Why'
text_overlay_spec.brand_mark: Top corner — '@serviceflow_ph' or 'SERVICEFLOW.' in tiny DM Sans light, 7px
text_overlay_spec.asterisk: ✱ floating near headline or in a corner — same serif font as headline
text_overlay_spec.cta: Bottom-right — '→  serviceflow.store' in tiny DM Sans, 7px

ai_generation_prompts.negative_prompts: no cool gray, no blue tones, no green, no neon, no pure black, no heavy makeup, no forced smiling, no stock photo, no busy background, no clinical/medical look, no harsh shadows, no flash photography, no cold tones whatsoever
ai_generation_prompts.canva_magic_media_prompt: Luxury beauty editorial, close-up dewy Filipino skin, warm golden hour light, amber and cream palette, honey color grade, intimate unposed, shallow depth of field, ESTHBeautyInc aesthetic

sample_post_brief._note: Example: How to use this profile to brief a post
sample_post_brief.photo_direction: Extreme close-up of Filipino woman's cheek/pore area, dewy glowing skin, warm amber sidelight, shallow DOF, honey color grade
sample_post_brief.overlay_gradient: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 40%, rgba(58,46,36,0.4) 100%) on bottom half

grid_rhythm.rule: 3-column Instagram grid — alternating photo-heavy, text/product, photo-heavy
never: 3 photo-heavy tiles in same row — break with at least one text/product tile
3 text-heavy tiles in same row — include at least one photo
3 tiles with the same background lightness in a row
recommend: Alternate warm-dark and warm-light backgrounds across each row
Product showcase tiles work best in center column
Overall grid should feel like a cohesive warm tapestry, not a random collage
